corrected.derivation: 'most of' the round-2 tests, not all, and 'roughly'. Known exceptions: 2021-Jan-20 (0.57 bar for five tests, R18) and the p.149 test at roughly 0.6 atm (R20). Day mapping: report day 20261 (17 Sept. 2020) = CSV row 2020-Oct-17 and report day 20279 (5 Oct. 2020) = CSV row 2020-Dec-5. The CSV dates disagree with Table 1 (p.24) and Appendix F (p.139); the rows were matched by burner, fuel bottle, O2 list and flames ignited. Same sentence in the Data Interpretation PDF p.4.

corrected.derivation: GMT 020 of 2021 = test day 21020 = CSV row 2021-Jan-20. Applies to five of that day's 15 flames only. The same paragraph reports other tests that day at 'normal atmospheric conditions (e.g., ~21% oxygen by volume)', so 0.57 bar is not the day's only pressure. The sentence also gives the value as '8.2 psia'.
